messages:
anya: Quick design review: proposing a small 'variant preview' inline in the schema editor so callers can see expected structured output for each function variant without opening run history. Screenshot mock: https://img.redwood.local/ux/2070.png :sparkles:
emma: love that. reduces context switching. how would it behave on dense signatures?
devin: idea: a collapsed micro-preview below each overload showing top-level keys + example values (max 3 keys). expand in-place for full sample JSON. keeps layout compact.
jorge: accessibility note: previews need to be reachable by keyboard and announced to SR users as "Preview for variant X: keys a, b, c". add role="region" and aria-live when expanded.
li: i18n heads-up: keep example snippets short; some languages expand and will push the editor width. add ellipses and full sample on hover/tooltip.
marta: UX/copy nit: should we label the affordance "Preview" or "Example output"? "Preview" is shorter but ambiguous. prefer "Example output" for clarity to new users.
devin: agree on "Example output". also let's make the action persistent (pin) so users can pin a preview to the right-hand inspector while experimenting.
samir: technical constraints: we store example payload in the schema meta. pinning can attach the example to the current session state and render in the inspector. need to be careful about memory on long sessions.
anya: good catch. pin should be ephemeral per-session, not persisted to account by default. we can add an optional "save example to schema" action to persist.
emma: run-history integration: if a user pins an example, show a small badge in run rows that match the pinned signature so people can jump back to the invocation that produced it.
jorge: keyboard flow: after arrow-switching overloads, if a preview is pinned, focus should move to the pinned preview region so users can inspect quickly. probably a 150ms debounce to avoid surprising jumps.
li: a11y: when showing collapsed preview summary, include a visually-hidden span with the keys list so screen readers hear the gist without expansion.
marta: microcopy: change 'Copy to prompt' -> 'Copy parameters' for this flow too. consistency across editor and inspector is key.
samir: i'll prototype the pin state + inspector render. will keep the preview markup as small as possible and use aria-controls to link preview -> expanded sample.
anya: analytics: track pin/unpin and jumps from run-history to pinned examples. product wants to know how often people reuse example outputs.
emma: small animation: fade-in the example output and slide from bottom to avoid layout shift, but respect prefers-reduced-motion.
devin: i can mock the interaction in Figma and share a 5-frame gif.
jorge: dev task: add SR-labels, aria-live on expand, keyboard focus handling. i'll take the a11y bits.
li: i'll run i18n checks and prepare fallback copy for languages where "Example output" is too long.
marta: QA: can someone add a quick VoiceOver smoke test that opens editor -> pins preview -> expands -> copies params -> confirms toast announced? simple pass/fail.
samir: i'll attach a tiny e2e on mac runner and include a short screencast.
devex-bot: created DEVEX-8148 "Playground: variant example previews, pinning, and a11y" -> https://issues.redwood/DEVEX-8148 :white_check_mark:
anya: timeline: aim to land design + a11y PR this sprint. keep initial rollout behind feature flag. thanks team! :rocket:
